content_sections.heading: NPOL JRF Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility is discipline-specific and is based on the essential educational qualification listed for each subject area. Candidates with an essential qualification degree from a foreign university must obtain an equivalence certificate from the Association of Indian Universities, Delhi, and submit it along with their application documents. All qualifications must be from recognized Universities/Institutions, and where NET/GATE is prescribed, it must be valid as on the date of the walk-in interview. Candidates already working in Government, Public Sector Undertakings, or Autonomous Bodies should apply through proper channel. For the Graduate level, "1st Division" refers to a B.Sc or B.Tech degree, as applicable. The equivalent acceptable subjects/disciplines for the essential qualification are as per RAC, DRDO norms, and NET is deemed to include other relevant national-level fellowships awarded by Central Government Departments/Agencies. The decision of the Director, NPOL, on the prescribed qualifications, their equivalence, and relevance to the Laboratory is final.

content_sections.heading: NPOL JRF Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for NPOL JRF Recruitment 2026 is entirely through a walk-in interview; there is no separate written examination or online screening stage described in the notification. Key points of the process: Candidates appear for the walk-in interview on the notified date, time, and venue, along with all required original certificates and self-attested copies A panel of selected candidates is drawn up for both the currently notified vacancies and future vacancies, and this panel remains operative for a period of one year Empanelment does not, by itself, entitle a candidate to an offer of Fellowship – an offer is contingent upon vacancies actually arising during the year The Director, NPOL, reserves the right not to select any candidate if suitable candidates are not available

content_sections.text: NPOL JRF Recruitment 2026 does not use an online application portal – interested and eligible candidates apply by appearing directly for the walk-in interview. The process is as follows: Appear for the walk-in interview on 10 October 2026 (Saturday) at 09:30 hrs, at Bhavan's Varuna Vidyalaya, in the campus of NPOL, Thrikkakara P.O., Kochi – 682021 Carry all certificates/testimonials/Community Certificate/valid GATE or NET Score Card, etc., in original, for verification at the time of interview Also carry a set of self-attested copies of all testimonials/certificates Carry an original ID proof (Voter's ID/Aadhaar Card/PAN Card/Driving Licence) Carry one recent colour passport-size photograph Optionally, prospective candidates may e-mail a one-page bio-data to [email protected] in advance, to help NPOL make the necessary administrative arrangements for the interview

faq.question: Q1. What is NPOL JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is Advertisement No. NPOL/JRF/01/2026 issued by the Naval Physical and Oceanographic Laboratory (NPOL), a DRDO laboratory under the Ministry of Defence, for selection to the position of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) across 7 disciplines, through a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under NPOL JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Mechanical Engineering has 4 confirmed vacancies. The remaining six disciplines – Computer Science & Engineering, Chemical Engineering/Rubber Technology/Polymer Technology/Nanotechnology/Materials Science, Opto Electronics, Electrical & Electronics/Electronics & Communication/Instrumentation Engineering, Physics, and Oceanography/Ocean Technology/Meteorology – have "Anticipated" vacancies, meaning the exact number is not fixed in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NPOL JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no online application or last date, since NPOL JRF Recruitment 2026 is conducted purely through a walk-in interview on 10 October 2026 (Saturday) at 09:30 hrs.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for NPOL JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification depends on the discipline – generally a BE/B.Tech with valid GATE, an ME/M.Tech in the relevant discipline, or (for Physics and Oceanography/Ocean Technology/Meteorology) a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science with valid NET/GATE. See the discipline-wise qualification table above for exact requirements.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NPOL JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 28 years as on the date of the walk-in interview, relaxable for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for NPOL JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through a walk-in interview and document verification. A panel of selected candidates is prepared for both current and future vacancies and remains valid for one year, though empanelment does not guarantee an offer of Fellowship.

faq.question: Q7. What is the stipend for NPOL JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selected Junior Research Fellows receive Rs. 37,000/- per month plus House Rent Allowance (HRA) as admissible, for an initial Fellowship period of two years, extendable as per rules.
